programme.title: WPT Gardens Poker Championship 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: There are four remaining in the fight for over $500,000. Chance Kornuth is looking to add another huge cash to his tournament poker resume but is trailing the new chip leader, Tuan Phan, by only a small margin. Jon Cohen and Markus Gonsalves are also very much a part of the battle as the fight to join the WPT Champion’s Club continues in Las Vegas.

programme.title: WPT Gardens Poker Championship 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: There are four remaining in the fight for over $500,000. Chance Kornuth is looking to add another huge cash to his tournament poker resume but is trailing the new chip leader, Tuan Phan, by only a small margin. Jon Cohen and Markus Gonsalves are also very much a part of the battle as the fight to join the WPT Champion’s Club continues in Las Vegas.

programme.title: WPT Gardens Poker Championship 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: As we approach a dramatic finish to the Gardens Casino WPT Main Event, the tides have turned. The final four players will play until a champion is crowned with the winner banking $554,695 to go along with their name inscribed on the Mike Sexton WPT Champions Cup.

programme.title: WPT Borgata 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: Six remaining players square off on the felt of the WPT Borgata Final Table where one player will be crowned a WPT Champion and receive over $600,000. WPT regular Veerab Zakarian is among the lucky few remaining and will take his seat with the chip lead. Brian Altman, James Anderson, Nathan Russler, Andrew Hanna, and Bin Weng will play alongside, as Vince Van Patten, and Tony Dunst provide commentary.

programme.title: WPT Borgata 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: The action continues at WPT Borgata. After the final table’s first elimination, five remaining players inch closer and closer to a WPT trophy. Stacks are deep and nobody is backing down.

programme.title: WPT Borgata 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: Veerab Zakarian leads the way of the three remaining at the WPT Borgata final table. Can he hang on to secure the title of WPT Champion or will one of the shorter stacks find a way to battle back? With $674,840 on the line, lots of action is to be expected.

programme.title: WPT L.A. Poker Classic 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: Another name will be added to the Mike Sexton WPT Champions Cup after the conclusion of the WPT L.A. Poker Classic Main Event, but first, a winner must be decided. Six remain from a field of 490 entrants and all will attempt to continue building a stack with their eye on the top prize of $1 Million Dollars.

programme.title: WPT L.A. Poker Classic 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: Bala Patur leads the way, but former WPT Champion Matas Cimbolas is heating up and is now only behind by a small margin. In the middle of the pack sits 2 time WPT champion James Carroll who will be looking to outlast the two shorter stacks at the table while also giving himself a shot at what would be his third WPT title.

programme.title: WPT L.A. Poker Classic 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: We are down to four players at the final table of the WPT L.A. Poker Classic. WPT Champion Matas Cimbolas, who finished second in this event in 2019, is still in the hunt for the title. Also in the hunt, two-time WPT Champion James Carroll, chip leader Bala Patur, and Scott Hempel who with this final table finish will record his largest poker cash to date.

programme.title: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: WPT hits Hollywood, FL to host the Seminole Hard Rock Poker Showdown. This tournament drew a field of 2,482 entrants marking the largest field of any WPT event. The field has narrowed to the final six remaining players with first place receiving $1,260,000.

programme.title: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: Sonny Franco has maintained the chip lead at this final table, but seasoned pro Brek Schutten is right on his heels. Also in the mix are Viet Vo, Steven Snyder, Albert Calderon, and Ken Aldridge as play gets back underway in Hollywood, Florida.

programme.title: WPT Seminole Hard Rock Showdown 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: It’s crunch time in Hollywood, Florida as only one of three remaining players can be crowned champion receiving over $1 million and have their name forever engraved in the Mike Sexton WPT Champions Cup.

programme.title: WPT Theta Network WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: WPT stops in Las Vegas, Nevada for a special edition of the Theta Network WPT Cash Game. The stakes are high with blinds at $100/$200 and there’s $360,000 on the table to start things off. The table features 4-time WPT champion Darren Elias and poker pro Ben Lamb facing off against some tough competition.

programme.title: WPT Theta Network WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: Thousands of dollars are flying around in this WPT cash game with lots of big action. Bill Perkins has struggled early on while Alex Ding has been running hot, but everyone is chasing pots in this high-stakes cash game clash.

programme.title: WPT Theta Network WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: 4-time WPT Champion Darren Elias sits alongside Ben Lamb, Bill Perkins, Lynne Ji, and Alex Ding as players compete for thousands of dollars in high stakes no-limit hold’em. With hundreds of thousands of dollars at stake, who will leave with the most cash?

programme.title: WPT Theta Network WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 4
programme.desc: WPT brings you the final leg of high-stakes cash in Las Vegas, Nevada. The players are deep-stacked and ready to make their mark before this cash game concludes. Lynne Ji is the big winner so far, up over $200,000, but Ben Lamb is looking to make a move and recoup some chips before the night is over.

programme.title: WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 1
programme.desc: High-stakes cash game action is in season, with three WPT champions Dan Weinman, Ema Zajmovic, and Frank Stepuchin contending for every pot. Also featured are poker grinders Cody Bell and Bruno Furth.

programme.title: WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 2
programme.desc: Things are heating up with over $100,000 on the table plus prop bet action galore. The poker grinders are giving the WPT Champions all they can handle so far in this high-stakes cash game.

programme.title: WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 3
programme.desc: The grinders are giving the champions a run for their money as this WPT high-stakes cash battle continues. Ali Imsirovic joins the table buying in for $100,000 to take his shot against WPT champion Ema Zajmovic.

programme.title: WPT Cash Game 2021 - Part 4
programme.desc: Prop bets are flying and there is plenty of high-level deep stack action at this table of poker pros. You can’t miss this final episode of a battle between WPT Champion Ema Zajmovic, Ali Imsirovic, Cody Bell, and Bruno Furth.

programme.title: Mr. Basketball’s Journey: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This documentary-style content chronicles the rich history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters, from their founding in 1926 to their rise as world-class athletes and entertainers. It highlights their groundbreaking 1948 victory over the Minneapolis Lakers, which helped legitimize black athletes in professional basketball. The story focuses on Mannie Jackson, a former player turned executive, who saved the team from extinction in the 1990s and revitalized their global brand. The Globetrotters’ influence on basketball, their unique blend of comedy and athleticism, and their philanthropic efforts around the world are also showcased, cementing their place as an iconic basketball and entertainment institution.

And Bulldog shares a tribute to his most important mentor and inspiration: his older brother. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Hoops, Hits & Hype With The Globetrotters
programme.desc: The Harlem Globetrotters hit Harlem with Snoop Dogg, teaming up with Steph & Klay for epic trick shots! Plus, a wild HORSE game with MLS Philly Union & NFL’s Marquette King brings the heat across sports. Hoops, hip-hop, and highlight-reel madness — you don’t wanna miss this!

programme.title: The Art of the Game
programme.desc: TNT spends time with family in her adopted hometown of Charlotte, NC; Hot Shot takes Wham to an aquarium in Kentucky that preserves aquatic wildlife. Coaches Lou and Handles help players cultivate their skills at the annual Showman’s camp in Atlanta.

programme.title: Highlife Hoops: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: The Harlem Globetrotters visit South Africa for the first time, blending basketball, culture, and community outreach on a historic global tour.

programme.title: Hometown Roots
programme.desc: Wham invites his elementary school teacher and her class on a field trip to a wildlife sanctuary in Georgia. Hammer invites Zeus to his adopted hometown of Tampa to enlighten high schoolers on the values of entrepreneurship. Hotshot and Cheese travel to Jet's hometown to support him while he's being honored. And TNT spends quality time with family in her adopted hometown of Charlotte, NC.

programme.title: Dunks Ep. 4
programme.desc: The best dunks from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Beats and Buses
programme.desc: Wham, Bulldog, and Hotshot fulfill a major need for a south central Los Angeles after-school program. Aspiring teen-girl music producers teach Jet, Bulldog, Wham, and Cheese how to make beats. Hotshot takes a touching look at the city that raised him in Harlem, New York. Hammer, Wham, and Bulldog have classic Guinness World Record moments. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Running to Grandma's Place
programme.desc: Bulldog and Wham visit a group of formerly homeless men who have dedicated themselves to daily running and each other. Cheese, Jet, and Hotshot travel to Harlem, New York to help teach local students the value of reading. Hammer and Torch learn about the delicious business of selling Gelato. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Trick Shots Ep. 1
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: The Sweet Lou Dunbar Story
programme.desc: Celebrate the incredible story of Sweet Lou Dunbar, a Harlem Globetrotters legend whose talent, charisma, and creativity helped define generations of show basketball. From his rise as a gifted player to his lasting impact as a showman, coach, and mentor, this special episode honors the man whose joy, leadership, and legacy continue to inspire players and fans around the world.

programme.title: Roundball Showdowns: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: An archival look at the Harlem Globetrotters’ history—from their origins and international goodwill tours (including South Africa) to charitable work and their enduring legacy.

programme.title: Globetrotting with STEAM
programme.desc: Wham visits his hometown of Stone Mountain, GA, to reconnect with family, friends, and his favorite childhood teacher before inviting her and her class on a field trip to a local animal sanctuary. Hammer, Hotshot, Torch, and Coach Lou visit a youth football league in South LA to learn how coaches are inspiring the community. Plus, Hotshot and Cheese hit the court in LA to challenge some locals to a pickup game.

programme.title: Harlem Globetrotters vs. the World - The Amazing Race All-Stars!
programme.desc: Get ready for a slam dunk of an adventure as Harlem Globetrotters Flight Time and Big Easy take on The Amazing Race All-Stars! From assembling toy cars in China and rappelling down roaring waterfalls in Malaysia to sewing shirts in Sri Lanka and navigating the ancient steps of Rome, these athletes face it all with a smile. Watch as they battle smoking taxis, navigate chaotic tuk-tuk lines, and even compete in a remote-controlled chariot race, proving that teamwork and a positive attitude are their greatest weapons. Will their undeniable rhythm and endless hustle be enough to keep them ahead of the pack?

programme.title: The Need for Speed
programme.desc: The Globetrotters twist into formation as they learn the historic tradition of Cuban Ballet in Miami. The team then meets the first professional female pit mechanic of color at a racing school before being invited to see her in action at a race in Indianapolis.

programme.title: Making the Cut
programme.desc: Tryouts for new Globetrotter Team Members are underway. Who will make the cut? Meanwhile, Jet, Wham, and Hotshot teach some South Central LA youth about the benefits of sports and exercise. And, the Globetrotters pay tribute to their legendary teammate Meadowlark Lemon.

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 Moto
programme.desc: Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa on the adventure of a lifetime as they explore the vibrant cities and stunning beaches of Morocco. Plus, enjoy exclusive bonus footage featuring the very best of GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E2 Moto
programme.desc: The journey continues as we follow two brothers on their 2,300-kilometer adventure across Morocco. Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa as they experience vibrant cities, breathtaking beaches, and the adventure of a lifetime. Plus, enjoy bonus footage of Jeremy Seewer. With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

programme.title: S2E1 Moto
programme.desc: Celebrate the women of GoPro, including British rally driver Catie Munnings, who rose to fame after winning the FIA European Rally Championship Ladies Trophy at just 18. Watch snowboarder Alina Hight who made history as the first to land a double backside alley-oop rodeo in a halfpipe competition. Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S3E1 Moto
programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. With eight Grand Prix victories and 32 podiums to his name, the Honey Badger spends his day off behind the wheel of supercars like the Ford GT, racing past Beverly Hills, the Sunset Strip, and into the winding roads of Benedict Canyon. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.
After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure.
From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells.
As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: The Journey Within

There, the grasslands and scattered thickets provide the perfect habitat for Bushed Tinamou, known for their elusive nature and penchant for hiding among dense underbrush. Day four is dedicated to hunting these Tinamou, with Mark eager to track them in their natural habitat. On day five, their focus shifts to Pigeons, where they set up decoys along the edge of a cut cornfield. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell.
GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads up to Steinhatchee after getting a call from local tournament angler Jay Andrew. The reds have been popping off and so the two head out in search.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: The second day in Steinhatchee, Capt. Blair & Jay finally find where all the reds got off too, and I mean ALL the reds. This is one of the craziest sights on the show yet.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: WoodHaven's Phillip Vanderpool pulls off one of the most incredible hunts of his career — taking down “Cyclops,” a 187” Kansas typical buck! This self-filmed hunt has it all: calling, decoying, and a shot from the ground. Watch as Phillip puts all his skills to the test and brings down one of his biggest bucks ever, completely captured on camera.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.
Kris and Flint Seymour hunt down a Kansas giant!

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Axis deer have always been an opportunity for Will Cooper—but never the main pursuit. In Chasing Spots, Will heads to Central Texas to hunt free-range Axis deer for the first time alongside good friend Casey Sanford. Hunting the opening of the Axis rut, the two battle summer heat, and cover miles of Texas Hill-Country.
Follow the founders: Joe Miles of Asio Gear and Andrae D’Acquisto of Lone Wolf Custom Gear as they hunt big bucks in Iowa, Texas and Mexico!

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: In this episode, Tyler sets up before daylight, calls in a stubborn gobbler, and gets a second chance at the bird that’s been haunting him.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Mark Kayser breaks down how to read elevation lines, hidden saddles, and thermal hubs to outsmart deer. Then, we head to the rugged breaks of Wyoming to see these strategies put to the test.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he journeys to his final destination in Namibia in pursuit of the elusive Damara Dik-Dik. These tiny antelope—famed for their large eyes and extremely shy nature—present a unique challenge even for a seasoned hunter. Active only in the early mornings and late evenings, their limited movement leaves Mark with a very narrow window of opportunity to successfully harvest one and cap off his African adventure.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they tag along side Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day! programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 208
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 207
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 206
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 205
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 204
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 103
programme.desc: “A Motorcycle Crime Story”: The horrific tale of a double murder over money and motorcycles.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 202
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 201
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ELVIS VAULT
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DISCOVERIES IN JERSEY
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BREAK UP TO MAKEUP
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BATTLE FOR ROME
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DRAGSTER DIPLOMACY
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - WOODIE WAGONS
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DAN GURNEY
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - VINTAGE RACING
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Voices: Killer Mike
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane: North America's greatest car show

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Fuller's Fab 5
programme.desc: Amelia Island's own Caffeine & Octane car show,: Featuring $2,000 Wrek Racing Truck, David Patterson's favorite C&O cars, a plastic Citroen Mehari, and much more.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Generation Amelia
programme.desc: The Concours d'Elegance from Amelia Island: Featuring bomb-proof Conquest Knight XV, '69 Camaro Hagerty Fixer-Upper, and car-enthusiast John Oates.

programme.title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengance - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Go Fast Collections - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.desc: The Yas Marina Circuit in Abu Dhabi is the most glamorous race track of the Formula One. Khaled Qubaysi takes us for a spin on this exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the famous race track.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Stéphane Peterhansel is the most successful driver in the history of the Dakar Rally. With the German team X-Raid he won the 2012 and 2013 editions of this prestigious competition in a Mini Countryman.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: For more than a century man and machine have tried to tame the Pikes Peak mountain, where daredevils risk everything to be the fastest up the 20-kilometer road to the summit at 4,300 meters above sea level. We show you the highlights of the 2018 race.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Former World Rally champion Armin Schwarz is a legend behind the wheel. We accompanied him when he instructed other talented drivers in a Subaru WRX STI rally car in the snowy and icy, but also breathtaking landscape of Finland.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The Tourist Trophy on the British Isle of Man is the most famous motorcycle race in the world. TT Sidecar champion Klaus Klaffenböck and racing expert Lenz Leberkern explore the fascination behind this exciting and iconic racing event.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: 1963, over 50 years ago, with the Quattroporte Maserati invented a new vehicle category, the sports sedan. This GTS model is already the 6th generation of this iconic car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the GTR, Nissan tried to take on the established European sports car manufacturers. For less than half the price the GTR was a more affordable direct competitor to Porsche's 911 Turbo S or the Audi R8 GT. In addition: one of the ultimate super cars, the Techart 911 Turbo S with 620 hp. And: the Pagani Huayra, presented and driven by Formula 1 Pilot Adrian Sutil.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: It's not always a car's pure power that makes driving through curves exciting. The Subaru BRZ with its low boxer engine and its well-balanced handling gives his driver a very good feeling for the road. The BMW 235i RS has a great rear wheel performance and the Porsche Cayman GTS with its mid-engine puts a smile on your face as soon as you put your foot on the accelerator.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the creation of its i8, Munich-based car manufacturer BMW makes a big step towards the future. After all, the futuristic looking car is the first German sports car which utilizes hybrid technology. Supercars checks out the BMW i8 on the streets of Los Angeles. But BMW did not just work on the i8. They also present the new sports coupe 435i and the sporty SUV X550d M.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you have only sat in the back of a big limousine and if you don't know how much these kind of limousines are, you are probably part of the management. When it comes to driving experience and performance, it makes sense that the driver¿s seat is less attractive. But that's only the case for seasoned state cars anyways. The Audi RS and Mercedes S-Class might even make some chauffeurs unemployed.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Highlights from the South Canterbury Rally in Timaru, where Ben Hunt claims victory after fast forest stages, mechanical drama and fierce NZRC battles. Featuring Darren Galbraith, team insight, historic action and commentary challenges.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz SL has been regarded as the sports car legend par excellence. Beginning with the legendary 300 SL with its gullwing doors, the SL series stands for innovation and cultivated sportiness.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: A car that everyone knows and that almost everyone has ridden in, a car that has conquered all continents and bears an unmistakable nickname, the Volkswagen Beetle.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The history of Olaf Manthey, a racing legend who has won the 24-hour race four times in a row. Stick around to find out the secret of his success.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel asked our presenter Miriam to participate in a driver safety training where he showed tips and tricks on what to do in emergency situations.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nürburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: Historic Formula V
programme.desc: In the late fifties in America, the first Formula V racers were produced. The goal: Affordable motor sport for everyone. The small, open wheel cars were seen on the race tracks until the end of the 70s. Then the series was stopped. About 20 years ago a couple of Formula V owners came together and established the "Historic Formula V Europe" as an association.

programme.title: Bentley S2 Continental Flying Spur
programme.desc: Flowing lines and an elegance that is unmatched. The 1959 Bentley S2 Continental Flying Spur aims to build bridges in the company's model range. From the sporty origin of the brand to the luxury of its new owner, Rolls Royce.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nowadays the gull-winged classic DeLorean is an automotive investment. Also: 100 dream cars under the hammer at a classic car auction in Switzerland. And: modern classics with investment potential like the Mercedes 190E 2.3 16V.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The BMW 328 'Schlüter' wrote racing history in the 1930s. Today, the unique car is operational again. Also: the TVR 3000M Cosworth is able to scare any Porsche out of its mind. And: a 60 years old Opel Kapitän gets a makeover.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the latest since a 1967 Toyota 2000 GT was sold at auction in the USA for 1.2 million dollars, Japanese classic cars have a different status. We present old and youngtimers "Made in Japan".

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Bentley New Flying Spur and the Rolls Royce Wraith are both an extremely exclusive breed of cars. These luxurious power packs make for an almost transcendental driving experience and deliver the perfect combination of elegance and performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: There are names that sound like music in car enthusiasts' ears: the Mc Laren MP4 12C, the Porsche 911 Turbo S and the Mercedes SLS AMG GT are super sports cars that are second to none. We put the pedal to the metal in these exciting and powerful driving machines.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 1,000 kilometers on the famous Nurburgring. It's the final race of the 2013 season. The Blancpain Endurance Series is a racing event for grand tourers like the Ferrari 458 Italia, the McLaren MP4-12 C or the Nissan GT-R Nismo GT3. We took a look at all the action, the drivers, their cars and the competition.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight

programme.desc: The Essen Motor Show is the event for automobile and motor sports enthusiasts. Over 300,000 visitors flock here every year and bring the hallowed halls to a boil.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: What's the perfect winter car for ultimate fun in the snow? The BMW X6 M and the Lada Niva have to prove themselves in the Ulten Valley in South Tyrol in Italy. Plus: High speed, adrenaline and pure action at the Snow Mobile show in Austria.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The search for the perfect winter car is still on. Patrick Simons puts the Subaru WRX STI and Audi RS6 Clubsport from MTM through their paces. Plus: With the MP4-12C, McLaren brings a successor to their famous F1 model to the streets.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Jetta is a big seller in the United States. With the sixth generation, Volkswagen wants the model to be successful with European car buyers, too. Plus: we take a look at the new Ford Focus and the BMX X3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Patrick Simon reviews the Porsche Cayenne S Hybrid. Below its hood is a 333 HP V6 engine and a 47 horsepower electrical motor. Plus: Upcoming racing driver Chris Bauer at the FIA GT1 championship at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Test driver Patrick Simon wants to take part in the 24 Hours of Le Mans and reviews his LMPC car. Plus: we compare the Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0 TDI to the Kia Sportage 2.0 CRDI.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Sometimes great things come in small packages like with the Mini John Cooper Works. Also: drifting in the Volkswagen Jetta at the Ice Experience in Sweden. In addition: the Steinbeisser Trophy. And: the Mercedes-AMG CLS 63.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: We were allowed to drive a car of Citroen's sub-brand DS who try to set foot in the Formula E. In addition: Citroen and Peugeot share the same platform with their Rifter and Berlingo models. And: the facelift of the 508, Peugeot's flagship car.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Eager to overcome the damage to their image following the diesel scandal, Volkswagen allowed exclusive sneak peaks into future developments. We took their T-Cross on a covered drive. In addition: a first glance at Audi's A1 and A6 models.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: We compared the Ford Mustang 2.3 EcoBoost turbo to BMW's 430i with similar engine and drive specs. Also: Lada tries to take on Dacia with their Vesta SW station wagon. And: Opel's Grandland X may be an SUV, but it doesn't offer an all-wheel drive.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Is Kia's visually exciting Stinger able to convince in our test? In addition: we explored how Subaru's Boxer engine concept works in their XV model. And: Hyundai i30N vs. Volkswagen Golf GTI.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Mustang celebrates its 50th anniversary at the Las Vegas Raceways and Marco takes part in this special event. He witnesses how tailor-made Shelby Cobras are manufactured and continues on his road trip through the US.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: How do conservative Californian petrolheads respond to a modern hybrid sports car like the BMW i8? On Marco's road trip through L.A. octane junkies who usually drive a Porsche 911, a Corvette or tuned bikes take the BMW to the test.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Kati from Munich is a big fan of US cars. She and her boyfriend fulfilled their dreams by buying a 1972 Chevy Chevelle that was found and imported directly from the USA by Frank Slopianka and his company Special Cars Berlin.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Mitsubishi Outlander Plug-In Hybrid, the world's first hybrid SUV with two electric motors and a 2-liter combustion engine. Also: the Chevrolet Silverado, an American full-size pickup with a V8 and an average consumption of at least 15 liters.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Bentley EXP 9F and Jaguar C-X17 are concept cars the two manufacturers presented before they started making their own luxury SUVs. Also: how did Toyota, Nissan or Subaru see the future of the SUV? And: Mercedes-Benz' Unimog concept car.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The SUVs Nissan X-Trail and BMW X4 aren't typical offroaders. We witnessed the presentation of the new X-Trail model and BMW's premiere of their X4. Also: the Steinbeißer Trophy, where unusual offroad vehicles take part in a demanding rally.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Volvo XC60
programme.desc: The Swedish landscape is characterized by mountains, forests and lonely roads. Ideal for this off-roader. The Volvo XC60 scores with many safety features and a cool appearance.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: A skidding lorry versus a remote-controlled van. Stunt coordinator Christoph Domanski`s plan is to separate the roof from the rest of the vehicle. If his idea works, the team will create a unique stunt convertible.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stunt man Dominik Kowalski is an expert for falls, drops and body stunts. Today, everything will be different as he is supposed to be the stunt car driver. His objective is to do a flip through a cola truck.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes have a new car cannon in their equipment arsenal that accelerates a car in one second from zero to 70 km/h. The team tests the cannon after shooting a wild car chase on the autobahn.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes turned a gravel quarry into their own stunt playground. This time, a motorbike without a driver flies over a ramp, a catapult for humans is tested and a new rollover punch is tried out in a fight scene.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Action Concept's stunt professionals are supposed to create a spectacular motobike jump with a subsequent crash that would be too dangerous for a stuntman. Stunt coordinator Ramazan Bulut has to come up with a solution.

programme.title: Lamborghini Huracan Spyder
programme.desc: The performance of the Lamborghini Huracan Spyder does not allow for any physical weaknesses or mental deficiencies. Above all the sound of its V10 natural aspirated unit that Audi also uses in the R8 is pure joy.

programme.title: KTM 990 Adventure
programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Italian super sports cars like the Ferrari La Ferrari, the Lamborghini Aventador or the Pagani Huayra are the most beautiful and fastest cars in the world, created by the best designers. Italian super sports cars are dreams made reality.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: British super sports cars like the Aston Martin Vanquish, the Bentley Continental GT Speed or McLaren's P1 are among the most spectacular and beautiful sports cars in the world. It's not just about power but also grace and style.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Whether it is the Porsche 918 Spyder, the Audi R8, the Mercedes AMG GT or the BMW i8 - German super sports cars are the fastest and most coveted in the world, with their breathtaking top speeds and incredible engine power.

programme.desc: The super sports cars by Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Pagani and Porsche are like Formula One racing cars for the streets, the fastest and most exciting cars in the world, whose power and performance seem to defy the laws of physics.

programme.title: COLLISION 5
programme.desc: The interim-GLORY Heavyweight Title will be up for grabs as top ranked heavyweight contender Antonio Plazibat (22-4, 16 KO) collides with the number two ranked Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (24-2-1, 12 KO) in the main event. These teammates will have to put their friendship aside for one night and go head-to-head for GLORY gold. Also on the card are title fights in the Middleweight, Welterweight and Light Heavyweight divisions.

programme.title: GLORY COLLISION 6
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer (29-5, 15 KO) meets Chico Kwasi (41-5, 22 KO). It’s also an important evening at middleweight with Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-8, 36 KO) colliding with Ulric Bokeme (31-4, 17 KO) and the recently debuted Iliass Hammouche (33-6, 7 KO) facing Ivan Galaz (58-10-1, 15 KO). A huge featherweight match-up between the number one ranked Abraham Vidales (15-2, 12 KO) and number two ranked Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO) plus an exciting light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni (41-8-1, 22 KO) and Stefan Latescu (16-2, 7 KO) will round out the main card.

programme.title: COLLISION 7
programme.desc: In the main event, ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven put his GLORY world heavyweight title on the line against number one contender ‘The Prince’ Levi Rigters in a hotly anticipated rematch from their GLORY Grand Prix final earlier this year. GLORY light heavyweight world champion Tarik Khbabez will collide with Donegi Abena in a trilogy fight to end their heated rivalry in the co-main event.

programme.title: COLLISION 8
programme.desc: Headlined by a high-stakes trilogy clash between Antonio Plazibat and longtime rival Nordine Mahieddine. Knockout artist Errol Zimmerman takes on former Australian strongman Alex Simon. Also, two explosive four-man, one-night tournaments in the welterweight and light heavyweight divisions—guaranteeing nonstop drama, finishes, and rising contenders.

programme.title: UFA 405 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 1 from London. Starting off is Dan Gittens stepping into the ring with Will Cairns while Pat Nash faces Danny Fletcher both fighters hoping to get their first Bare Knuckle win. George Hillyard challenges Jimmy Bryan making his Bare Knuckle debut. Watch as two powerhouses fight next as Kamil Sokolowski from Poland takes on Ukranian Volodymyr Skurtu. Also in this episode, Brad Scott and Martyn Grainger face off in a cruiserweight title clash and Marko Martinjak current champion trades punches with Kevin Greenwood in a world light heavyweight title challenge.

programme.title: UFA 406 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 2 from London. Starting off this great night of combat, Eryk Majda steps into the ring with Tyrone Eliffe in what is expected to be the fight of the night in this light heavyweight title fight. Next up defending champion Ionel Levitchi faces challenger Tony Shields for the British lightweight title belt. Watch as Liam Rees and Corey Healey take to the ring in a Wales versus Wales contest in a well matched fight for the flyweight title. Plus you won't want to miss the heavyweight bout between Dominic Negus versus Stanlee Wilson.

programme.title: UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: UFA 480 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Up first in a kickboxing middleweight bout are Vitalie Matei and Calin Petrisor - the KO Hunter. The main event is a superfight boxing matchup, World Champion Flavius Biea takes on The Hyena Daniel Corbeanu.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes 11
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 11 features SFT's Bianca Sattlemeyer who steps into the cage with Florencia Aleona Greco, Julia Polastri takes on Jessica Cunha and female fightes from Caged Fury Tecia Torres and Rebecca Gruitza take to the cage. Don't miss the featured fighters from Blackeye Barb Honchak versus Roxanne Modafferi.

programme.title: UFA 434 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 1 from Houston, Texas. In the first match, Stephen Acosta takes on Brian Soto in a four round super flyweight bout. In the 8 round co-main event undefeated Antonio Perez faces veteran boxer Alex Martin in the Superlight weight division

programme.title: UFA 438 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 2 from Houston, Texas. In the Featherweight division, Emmanuel Carrillo Jr. takes on Jordan Najar. In the main event, undefeated Bantamweights Khalid Twaiti and Emanuel Moreno face off in an eight round matchup after an contentious weighin.

programme.title: UFA 349 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 1 from Bucharest Romania. Watch four kickboxing battles on this episode of UFA. Starting out The Ironman, Denis Ceausu takes on Marius Cimpoeru, then Ali Gokturk Benli faces Andrei Leustean in a Turkey versus Romania bout. Florentin Ionescu takes on the more experienced Mihai Zmarandescu and Omer Pisgin takes on fan favorite The Shephard, Bogdan Nastase.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 2 from Bucharest Romania with a night of Kickboxing action. programme.title: UFA 368 - BKB 35 - Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 35 part 1 from London. programme.title: UFA 369 - BKB 35 - Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 35 part 2 from London. In this episode of UFA Jack McLean and Dan Gittens both out of London take to the ring, Benji Robinson meets Gavin Curragh in the ring and Liam Wilson, making his BKB debut, faces Tony Shields. In the co-main event for the World cruiserweight title, CJ Mills and Carl Hobley battle for the belt and in the main event defending champion Jimmy Sweeney (27-4) faces challenger Marley Churcher in a contest for the World Welterweight Title.

programme.title: UFA 428 - Clan Wars 51 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Starting off the night, Jack McCrory squares off against Peter Thompson and in two back to back female fights, Gemma Coghill faces the younger Alexa Pagaduan, while Anneka Bower takes on Lisa Murtagh. Also in this episode Conor McAlister and Kelsey Crossey face off in the catchweight division while Michael Swann and Cian Sweeney take to the cage.

programme.title: UFA 431- Clan Wars 51 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. First up in this episode Justis Neun takes on Callum Carville in the catchweight division while Ricardo Dearaujo takes on Andy Wilders in a flyweight bout. Watch as Simon Sackey takes to the cage with Maksims Torskis in the heavyweight division. In a bantamweight contest, Ronan Deegan faces Adrian Barrow and Kelsey Crossey is matched up agains Jason McCourtney for a catchweight bout. In a match for the vacant featherweight Clan Wars title, Jede Paulo fights Nathan Chambers for the belt.

programme.title: UFA 435 - Clan Wars 51 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 3 from Belfast, Ireland. In the featherweight division Nikola Ivanovic faces Damien McKenna in an MMA matchup and Fynn O'Neill takes on Padraig Irvine in the Catchweight fight. Ash Williams and Ciaran Mullholand take to the cage while Kian McCarton takes on Billy Sutherland for the Flyweight title. In the main event Lethal Shea Leathem challenges Jamie the Spider Monkey McCaugherty in a Welterweight championship title fight.

programme.title: UFA 470 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off this episode is Gebril Chaibi versus Miguel Guzman in a flyweight bout followed by a light heavyweight matchup as Blair Sannoh and Emmanueli Adzoh step into the cage. In the main event, Anthony "The Bully" Romero takes on Ricardo Diaz, the Brazillian veteran, for the vacant UNF Bantamweight title.

programme.title: UFA 474 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In ther first bout, Angel Becerra steps into the cage with undefeated Carson Dohan. In the lightweight division, veteran Darion Champman looks to stop Diego Perez' three bout winning streak. Up next grappler Joe Murphy returns to the cage for a match against boxer Luciano Ramos in a catchweight bout.

programme.title: UFA 479 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 3 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Young prospect Joseph Rodriguez looks to keep his undefeated record intact against Jesse Langarica making his pro debut in a catchweight bout. programme.title: NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Purdue vs. Creighton
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Tied at 2-2 entering the broadcast, this match features intense mixed doubles action that decides the series.Key matchups include Purdue’s Emma Jones and Jay Barath facing off against Creighton’s Russell Lee and Lucy. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

programme.title: 2024 NPL – Women’s Team Match – Scorpions vs Iconics
programme.desc: The Coachella Valley Scorpions take on the Denver Iconics in a thrilling women’s National Pickleball League showdown from the 2024 season. From powerful baseline drives to lightning-fast net battles, both teams bring competitive spirit and polished teamwork to the court. Whether you're a seasoned fan or new to the NPL, this match showcases the rising talent and intensity of women’s pro pickleball. Every point matters — and momentum can shift in a flash.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 - Loyola Marymount University vs. Baylor University
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the NCPA Nationals in Saint Louis as the LMU Lions and Baylor Bears battle in a high-stakes best-of-seven series. The competition ignites with the Racing speed of rapid-fire volleys during an intense "equipment battle" between the power of the Selkirk Boomstick and the precision of Team Joola. Masterful Skills are on display as athletes execute flawless Around the Post (ATP) winners and tactical dink rallies that keep the pressure mounting. Amidst the Freestyle creativity of the collegiate circuit, witness morale-shifting momentum swings and desperate scrapping for every point as these top-tier programs fight for national dominance.

programme.title: NPL - Stingers vs United (Mens)
programme.desc: The Kansas City Stingers face off against the Seattle United in a men's match.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023 - Mixed Doubles 4
programme.desc: Kyle Yates & Picklebowl host Danny Wuerffel team up against pro-pickleball star Megan Fudge & former tennis player Amer Delic.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 Semifinal - Utah Tech vs. Florida Atlantic University
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center in Saint Louis reaches a fever pitch as the Utah Tech Trailblazers face off against the FAU Owls in a high-stakes semifinal showdown. This match showcases a "racing" intensity as Liam Duffin looks to maintain Utah Tech's momentum following their grueling victory over Colorado. Fans are treated to the technical "skills" and "freestyle" shot-making of Alex LaMacchia, whose crafty drop shots and highlight-reel volleys keep the score neck and neck throughout the opening game. With a spot in the National Championship on the line, both squads must navigate high-pressure video challenges and tactical timeouts in a match many spectators believe is worthy of the final itself.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Fuzesi/Maalouf
programme.desc: Watch as the formidable mother-daughter duo, Lee and Anna Leigh Waters, take on challengers from North Carolina in this Pro Women's Doubles match from the US National Pickleball Center. After an injury, it is great to see the champions partner up again, demonstrating the "fire and ice" style of play that has made them national champions. While the Waters team's game one was a quick 11-point victory, the challengers, Fuzesi and Maloof, handled themselves well on the championship court. The players at home can learn from Anna Leigh's "instigator" shots and two-handed backhand rolls, which she helped bring to the big stage.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 - Women's Senior Pro Singles - Gold
programme.desc: Watch Jennifer Dawson battle it out for gold against Leslie Bernard in this Women's Senior Pro Singles match at the US Open Pickleball Championships 2023.

programme.title: WPBL 2025 - Delhi vs. Mumbai Day 2 Tie 2
programme.desc: The action continues on Day 2 of the World Pickleball League (WPL) with the highly anticipated second matchup: Delhi takes on Mumbai Pickle Power at the CCI Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai.This matchup features a spectacular lineup, including Delhi's players Alexa Schule, Eduardo Irizarry, and Willie Chung, against a strong Mumbai squad that includes Brandon Lane, Glauca Lane, and Kim Ngo.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Gold Medal Match
programme.desc: Anna Leigh Waters and J.W. Johnson take on Megan Fudge and Andrei Daescu in this Mixed Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: Florida vs. Virginia
programme.desc: The 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches its peak as the University of Florida and the University of Virginia face off in a high-stakes Semifinal and Final showdown. The intensity is palpable from the very first "time in," with athletes showcasing elite precision in specialized Skills challenges and explosive speed during the high-octane Racing segments. Between strategic volleys and creative Freestyle maneuvers, neither side gives an inch as the score oscillates through razor-thin margins, trading momentum with every "right back" play. This clash of titans proves why these two programs are the gold standard of collegiate pickleball, where every "point two" earned is a grueling step toward national history.

programme.title: WPBL 2025 - Delhi vs. Hyderabad - Day 6 Tie 2

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Hyderabad vs Delhi - Day 6 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden as the high-stakes battle for the top four intensifies between the Hyderabad Superstars and Delhi Dilwale. With legendary co-owner Sunil Gavaskar watching from the sidelines, the Dilwale look to maintain their winning streak against a fiercely aggressive Hyderabad squad known for their wild celebrations and relentless energy. This tie features a series of high-octane clashes, from the strategic precision of Shawn Mendes and Alejandra Lopez in women’s singles to the "grueling" 15-minute sprints of elite doubles play. As the "Band of Honor" leaderboard hangs in the balance, every rally becomes a desperate fight for survival in one of the world's most prestigious pickleball arenas.

programme.title: Semifinals - Virginia vs. Florida
programme.desc: Witness a clash of collegiate giants as the University of Virginia and the University of Florida battle for a spot in the finals at Performance Pickleball RVA. The intensity is at an all-time high after Florida's grueling "dream breaker" victory over NC State to reach this stage. Elite talent takes center stage, featuring former D1 tennis stars like Laura Font and Norwegian standout Martinez Sunstein facing off against Virginia’s deep roster of defending champions. From powerful serves to tactical kitchen play, every point counts in this high-stakes quest for a championship bid.

programme.title: NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - GCU vs. Hawaii
programme.desc: We are live from the Barnes Tennis Center in San Diego, California, for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This thrilling collegiate team match features Grand Canyon University (GCU) taking on the University of Hawaii. The broadcast picks up in the heat of the action during a crucial mixed doubles game, with GCU leading. Watch as the match extends into a dramatic Sudden Death Dreambreaker (Game 7) to decide the winner. The episode highlights the unique collegiate format where every point counts towards seeding for the National Championship. Key players include Hawaii's Tristan Simmons and Tama, battling against GCU's Tanner and Hannah. The match concludes with a high-stakes finish that determines who moves forward in bracket play.

Expect fast-paced exchanges, smart teamwork, and big momentum swings as both teams battle for bragging rights and a good cause. Blending professional play with the spirited energy of Picklebowl, this match is a crowd favorite you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Kao/DeHeart vs. Fudge/Munro
programme.desc: Watch a thrilling Mixed Pro Doubles pickleball match between the top-seeded team of Megan Fudge and Jack Munro against Peichuan Kao and Ryler DeHeart. Megan Fudge is a highly-ranked professional player who previously played tennis at the University of Illinois, where she met her husband and partner, Ryler DeHeart. DeHeart is a former professional tennis player who is left-handed. Their opponents are Peichuan Kao, a professional pickleball player who won gold at the APP Fort Lauderdale Open, and Jack Munro, a young pro who was the youngest to become a professional at age 12.

With fast-paced exchanges, sharp angles, and tactical precision, both teams battle for a spot in the finals on the prestigious Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida. This high-stakes match features standout teamwork and thrilling rallies from some of the sport’s most skilled competitors.

Watch as UVU's Sophia Thompson and Ali Evanson attempt to protect their undefeated record against GCU’s Brenna Murray and former BYU tennis star Dodo Kong in a hard-hitting women’s doubles opener. The intensity shifts to the men's doubles as UVU's Tyler Miller and Thatcher Schwendimann face a strategic challenge from GCU's Adam Jones and Artur Fonseca, a beach tennis specialist from Brazil. With a spot in the finals on the line, this match showcases elite collegiate talent, "body bag" shots, and the fierce school spirit that defines the DUPR circuit.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 Grand Final - Chennai vs Delhi - Day 13 Tie 1
programme.desc: The grand finale of the World Pickleball League Season 2 descends upon Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for an unforgettable clash of titans between the Chennai Super Champs and Delhi Dilwale. Witness the technical mastery of Rika Fujiwara as she faces off against Alejandra Lopez in a high-stakes women’s singles match that sets the tone for the entire championship. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during a mixed doubles "masterclass" featuring Max Mansoor and Trang Huynh, which commentators hailed as the potential "rally of the season". With the "Band of Honor" and the ultimate league trophy on the line, every strategic "Pickle Play" and nerve-wracking volley contributes to an atmosphere so electric the crowd and commentators alike are left "going berserk".

Filmed at a championship stop on the NPL tour, this intense match features fierce net battles, pinpoint placement, and relentless energy on both sides of the court. Watch as Carter & Ojeda push the pace and mount a relentless offensive, while Zelenski & Kordic Mueller counter with sharp angles and strategic resets. A hard-fought final that captures the spirit, skill, and teamwork of professional women’s pickleball.
